_comment: Machine-readable IDs for the seven domains. The *rules* live in the vault:
99 Meta/Conventions.md            - naming, frontmatter, statuses, the GTD rule
99 Meta/Project Reconciliation.md - invariants, the reconcile procedure, finding types
This file holds only the opaque IDs those notes cannot express (Todoist parent IDs,
Drive folder IDs). If a domain is added or a parent project is recreated, edit this
file and the Domains table in Conventions.md together - nothing else needs to change.
_someday_comment: `someday_project_id` is the domain's `Someday / Maybe` holding pen - see the Someday /
Maybe section of Conventions.md. Every domain has its own, exactly like One-Off, and for
the same reason: a holding pen never completes, so the GTD, stalled and missing-note
checks all skip it by rule. Adding a domain now means adding five things, not four.
_one_off_comment: `one_off_project_id` is the domain's One-Off bucket - see the One-Off Tasks section
of Conventions.md. A domain parent holds no tasks directly; everything lives in a
real project or in that domain's One-Off. One-Off projects are permanent buckets,
so scripts skip them structurally: no GTD check, no stalled check, and never
reported as missing an Obsidian note or Drive folder. Same treatment as each domain's
someday_project_id - both are rules, not preferences, so there is no human-maintained
exclusion list anywhere in this file.
